files.quota-pair-run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /probe/quota-pair-out
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-level=debug --log-time=1 --log-target=file:/probe/quota-pair-out/pulse.log --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/pw BROWSER=webkit
cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js
for mode in default norewinds; do
 dir=/probe/quota-pair-out/$mode
 mkdir -p "$dir"
 RESET_SINK=$mode timeout 45 node /probe/sim/web/test/cold-probe.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir/cold" > "$dir/cold.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/cold-exit-status"
 cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat > "$dir/cpu-before.txt"
 timeout 120 node /probe/sim/web/test/audio-loopback.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir/audio" 30 > "$dir/audio.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/audio-exit-status"
 cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat > "$dir/cpu-after-audio.txt"
 timeout 180 node /probe/sim/web/test/editor-ui.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir/ui" > "$dir/ui.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/ui-exit-status"
 cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat > "$dir/cpu-after-ui.txt"
done
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/quota-pair-out
files.cold-unmarked-run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /probe/cold-unmarked-out
pulseaudio --version > /probe/cold-unmarked-out/version.txt
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-target=file:/probe/cold-unmarked-out/pulse.log --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/pw BROWSER=webkit
cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js
sha256sum /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js /probe/sim/web/www/fm1.wasm > /probe/cold-unmarked-out/hashes.txt
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat > /probe/cold-unmarked-out/cpu-before.txt
for i in 1 2 3; do
 for mode in default norewinds; do
  dir=/probe/cold-unmarked-out/$mode-$i
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  RESET_SINK=$mode timeout 45 node /probe/sim/web/test/cold-unmarked-probe.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir" > "$dir/run.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/exit-status"
  pactl list short modules > "$dir/modules.txt"
 done
done
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat > /probe/cold-unmarked-out/cpu-after.txt
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/cold-unmarked-out
